description: QuNetSim is a quantum-enabled network simulator that adds common quantum networking tasks like teleportation, superdense coding, sharing EPR pairs, etc. With QuNetSim, one can design and test robust quantum network protocols under various network conditions.
whatItIs: QuNetSim is an open-source project in the networking category. It is maintained by tqsd and primarily looks like a Python codebase. QuNetSim is a quantum-enabled network simulator that adds common quantum networking tasks like teleportation, superdense coding, sharing EPR pairs, etc.

For readers mapping the ecosystem, this resource is useful because it shows how one team approaches networking workflows in practice.
